text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So many... Thank you very much. ...I will 
take them... to that room.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is a shared space with Tachyon-san... 
...I have to be careful so she doesn't 
experiment on me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... please come visit these little ones 
every now and then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... "everyone" will welcome you, 
Trainer... Fufu.
